title: Raccoon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <rect x="32" y="72" width="9" height="18" rx="4" fill="#6B7B99"/>
  <!-- Left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#4A5A78"/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <rect x="54" y="68" width="9" height="18" rx="4" fill="#6B7B99"/>
  <!-- Right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#4A5A78"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M68 70 Q82 60 80 45 Q78 35 72 40 Q68 48 64 62" fill="#8B9BB5" stroke="#A8B8D0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M74 50 Q76 44 73 40" fill="none" stroke="#5A6A88" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 60 Q80 54 78 49" fill="none" stroke="#5A6A88" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="60" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#8B9BB5"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="13" ry="13" fill="#B0C0D8"/>

  <!-- Left arm (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d="M32 52 Q20 42 16 30" stroke="#8B9BB5" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Left hand -->
  <circle cx="16" cy="28" r="4.5" fill="#4A5A78"/>

  <!-- Right arm (raised other side) -->
  <path d="M62 50 Q74 40 78 28" stroke="#8B9BB5" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Right hand -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="26" r="4.5" fill="#4A5A78"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="36" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#8B9BB5"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="22" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#6B7B99"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="23" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#B0C0D8"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="22" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#6B7B99"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="23" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#B0C0D8"/>

  <!-- Face mask (raccoon dark mask) -->
  <path d="M28 34 Q33 28 40 32 Q44 34 48 32 Q52 34 56 32 Q63 28 68 34 Q70 40 64 42 Q56 44 48 42 Q40 44 32 42 Q26 40 28 34 Z" fill="#4A5A78"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#2A3A58"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#E0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#2A3A58"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#E0F0FF"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="41" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#2A3A58"/>
  <!-- Snout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="43" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#B0C0D8"/>

  <!-- Mouth (happy) -->
  <path d="M43 45 Q48 50 53 45" fill="none" stroke="#4A5A78" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Head highlight / white forehead stripe -->
  <path d="M44 24 Q48 20 52 24 Q50 28 48 30 Q46 28 44 24 Z" fill="#D0E0F0"/>

  <!-- Musical notes for dancing -->
  <g fill="#FFD700">
    <ellipse cx="14" cy="14" rx="3" ry="2.2" transform="rotate(-20 14 14)"/>
    <rect x="16" y="4" width="1.5" height="11" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <ellipse cx="84" cy="12" rx="3" ry="2.2" transform="rotate(-20 84 12)"/>
    <rect x="86" y="2" width="1.5" height="11" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <ellipse cx="89" cy="20" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" transform="rotate(-20 89 20)"/>
    <rect x="91" y="12" width="1.2" height="8" fill="#FFD700"/>
  </g>
</svg>
